title: Modular Entitlement Framework: staged SSO/SAML commitments and RBAC tier pricing experiment
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Enterprise customers are asking for SSO/SAML and fine-grained RBAC commitments in contracts, but a full blanket commitment across all tiers increases cost and sales friction. Goal: Design and validate a modular entitlement approach that lets sales and legal offer staged SSO commitments (trial -> pilot -> guaranteed) and tiered RBAC SLAs as optional paid add-ons, and measure impact on conversion, deal size, and legal risk. This ticket covers the PM experiment design, contract language variants, pricing knobs, and first-round pilot with two strategic accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Define 3 entitlement levels for SSO/SAML (No-commit, Pilot commitment, Contracted guarantee) with clear technical and operational obligations for each level
Define 2 RBAC service tiers (Default role mapping, Managed role templates + audit logs) and associated pricing and SLA language
Produce 3 contract clause variants (concise pilot clause, standard guarantee, and opt-out appendix) and get Legal sign-off on minimum risk language
Deploy a one-pager for Sales + Solutions to use in negotiations and track usage via a CRM tag
Run 4-week pilot with 2 customers and collect conversion and feedback metrics (time to signature, redlines, security questionnaire passes)
tasks: Draft entitlement level definitions (PM) - deliverable: entitlement matrix
Coordinate with Security & Legal to map technical controls to contract obligations
Create pricing model for add-ons and simulate ACV impact across three deal-size buckets
Produce sales enablement one-pager and negotiation playbook
Open pilot proposals with two target customers and capture redlines/objections
Instrument CRM and tracking tags for offers and outcomes
notes: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Kickoff - scoped problem with Sales leadership (Ava Thompson) and Security (Rajiv Menon). Agreed to a modular approach instead of a universal guarantee. Identified two pilot customers (EnterpriseA, EnterpriseB).

2026-03-04 Rajiv Menon (Security): Technical mapping draft completed - lists required controls for Pilot vs. Guaranteed commitments (SAML metadata rotation cadence, 24/7 auth incident response for Guaranteed tier). Legal asks for explicit SLA language around recovery windows.

2026-03-07 Ethan Park (PM): Price model initial run shows ~8-12% increase in ACV when RBAC Managed Tier is purchased by mid-market customers; enterprise customers expect SSO guarantee bundled in top-tier only. Recommendation: expose add-on as optional productized SKU.

2026-03-09 Legal review (Ana Rivera): Submitted three clause variants. Recommended limiting Guaranteed SLA to customers with Dedicated/Dedicated+Private deployments and including clear termination and indemnity carve-outs. Suggested pilot clause with 90-day evaluation and no penalty for limited outages during pilot.

2026-03-11 Design review (Liam Ortiz): Sales one-pager mockups reviewed. Feedback: separate technical obligations sheet for Solutions Engineers to attach to proposals, avoid legalese on customer-facing doc.

2026-03-12 Ethan Park: CRM instrumentation added (tag: sso_modular_experiment). Sales asked to tag all offers; Solutions to capture security questionnaire outcomes. Pilot proposal sent to EnterpriseA; awaiting redline.

2026-03-13 Maya Chen: Next steps - schedule kickoff with EnterpriseA security team, legal to prepare a negotiated appendix template, finalize pricing SKU list, and set telemetry dashboard for conversion metrics.
